checkpoints: Dockerfile 和 CI 配置文件名应清晰反映其用途，避免过于简略的命名。
文件命名应遵循项目已有的命名约定。

antipattern.code:
# wangxiyuan 评审: "rename file to a better one"
# 文件名不够描述性，需要重命名为更具描述性的名称

FROM quay.io/ascend/cann:8.3.rc1-ubuntu22.04-py3.11

# Nightly CI pre-built image for A2
ARG VLLM_COMMIT="main"
ENV VLLM_WORKSPACE=/workspace

WORKDIR $VLLM_WORKSPACE

RUN git clone https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm.git \
    $VLLM_WORKSPACE/vllm && \
    cd $VLLM_WORKSPACE/vllm && \
    git checkout $VLLM_COMMIT && \
    VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE="empty" pip3 install -v -e . && \
    pip3 uninstall -y triton

# ... install vllm-ascend dependencies ...
